name: handlePatientDataRequest
shortDescription: Processes patient requests for data access, correction, or deletion in compliance with privacy regulations.
description:
Overview

This function processes requests from patients regarding their data rights, such as access, correction, or deletion, ensuring compliance with data protection laws like HIPAA.

Intended use

Called by the patient-facing UI or an admin interface when a patient or administrator submits a data rights request. Parameters include patientId, requestType ('access', 'correction', 'deletion'), and relevant details for the request.

Logic

  1. Validate the patientId and requestType.
  2. Based on the requestType:
    • For 'access': Retrieve all relevant data from Patient, MedicalRecord, and Consent entities using ctx.data.query.
    • For 'correction': Update specific fields in Patient or MedicalRecord as per the request, using ctx.data.update.
    • For 'deletion': Soft-delete relevant records from Patient, MedicalRecord, and Consent using ctx.data.delete, or mark them for deletion.
  3. Audit-log the data request and its fulfillment using ctx.audit.log, including the patient, request type, and outcome.
  4. Return a confirmation of the request processing.

Entities

  • Patient
  • MedicalRecord
  • Consent
  • AuditLog
